name: Packaging DWH (production)
role: The data warehouse being migrated: 24 tables in mfg, sales, supply, quality

evidence.excerpt: Nordic Pack AB runs one SQL Server 2019 warehouse, `PACKDWH01\veloxpool`

meaning: Nordic Pack's on-premises SQL Server 2019 warehouse for twelve plants; the system whose licence ends in March 2027
impact: The migration source: every table, procedure and view in this run belongs to it
risk: The database name on this instance is not stated anywhere; the Scope sign-in must confirm it

recommendation.reason: Named by the spec, the DDL export headers and the DBA

name: Packaging DWH test copy
role: Read-only test copy of SYS-1 created for the migration; source of the row-count export

evidence.excerpt: a login `velox_reader` (db_datareader + VIEW DEFINITION) was created on the test copy

meaning: A copy of the warehouse that the migration team may read, reached through a public tunnel host
impact: The place Scope and reconciliation can read today without touching production
risk: It is loaded at demo size, so counts read from it do not describe production volume (FND-15)

recommendation.reason: Config and interview agree it is the migration's read-only copy

name: MES (manufacturing execution system)
role: Source of production runs, read nightly through linked server MES_EU

conflicts.note: the proc reads catalog `mes`, the config names database MES_PROD

meaning: The shop-floor system that records every production run on the lines
impact: Wave 1 needs a new ingestion path from it; the linked server does not exist on Databricks
risk: If the proc reads a different database than MES_PROD, the ingestion points at the wrong source (OQ-08)

recommendation.reason: Config and procedure both name it; database name to confirm

name: SAP ECC export file share
role: Nightly SAP flat files (order lines, orders, purchase orders, shipments) landed with bcp
meaning: The Windows share where SAP drops its nightly sales and supply extracts as CSV files
impact: Wave 2 needs file ingestion (e.g. Auto Loader) or a direct SAP connector in its place
risk: File layouts and archive policy are unknown; a wrong guess re-loads or skips days

recommendation.reason: Config and job agree on the share and file patterns

name: WMS (warehouse management system)
role: Stock extract read by the inventory snapshot through table wms.stock_extract
meaning: The warehouse-management system whose daily stock positions feed the inventory snapshot
impact: Wave 2 must re-create the stock feed; who fills wms.stock_extract is not shown
risk: If the extract is produced inside the DWH by an unseen job, that job is missing from scope

recommendation.reason: Code and spec both name it; engine and host unknown

name: QMS web app
role: Writes quality.Complaint directly and calls quality.sp_Close_Complaint

evidence.excerpt: Called by the QMS web app when a complaint is closed.

meaning: The quality team's complaint application, which uses a warehouse table as its own database
impact: Wave 3 waits until this app stops writing to the warehouse (kickoff)
risk: Moving quality.Complaint before the app is split breaks complaint handling

name: LIMS (laboratory system)
role: Loads quality.LabTestResult hourly; a catch-up step runs inside DWH_Nightly
meaning: The lab system that records material and product test results
impact: Wave 3 needs an hourly feed; the loader's code is not in the folder
risk: An hourly feed missed in scope leaves LabTestResult stale on the target

recommendation.reason: Spec and job history agree; code missing

name: Power BI service
role: Datasets Plant performance (06:00) and Sales cockpit (06:30) read the warehouse
meaning: The BI service whose two datasets are the main readers of OEE and sales data
impact: Datasets must be repointed to Databricks SQL; the model rewrite itself is out of scope
risk: Logic inside the models (UTC conversion, de-duplication) is lost if not captured (FND-12)

name: SSRS report server
role: rpt_open_receivables daily 07:00 and rpt_complaints_weekly on Mondays
meaning: The report server that sends Finance its dunning list and Quality its weekly complaints
impact: Its reports must be repointed; SSRS retirement is out of scope
risk: Report-level expressions may carry rules no procedure holds

recommendation.reason: Spec names both reports; one has run history

name: Group sustainability platform
role: Receives a monthly extract of energy readings and shipment CO2

evidence.excerpt: Monthly extract to the group sustainability platform: `mfg.EnergyReading`, `supply.Shipment.Co2Kg`

meaning: The group-level platform that collects energy and CO2 figures for sustainability reporting
impact: The extract must keep running from Databricks; how it runs today is not shown
risk: A monthly extract with no code in the folder is easy to forget at cut-over

name: ETL server ETL02
role: Runs dwh_nightly.py at 01:00 under a service account

evidence.excerpt: Runs on the ETL box ETL02 under the service account svc_dwh_etl at 01:00

meaning: The Windows/Linux box that runs the Python half of the nightly load
impact: Its job becomes a Lakeflow Job; the box is retired with the warehouse
risk: Other scripts on this box that touch the warehouse would stay unseen

recommendation.reason: Named in the job's own docstring
